title: Bhai Dooj on a Thali
prompt: A tiny miniature sister and brother, each about two centimetres tall, sit cross-legged facing each other in the centre of a giant polished brass puja thali; the sister gently presses a red roli tilak onto her brother's forehead and both smile softly. She wears a magenta silk lehenga with a gold border, he wears a cream kurta with a saffron dupatta. Around them lie rice grains as big as pillows, a heap of red kumkum like a small hill, and a lit clay diya whose flame towers behind them like a bonfire; marigold petals are scattered on a dark wooden floor at night. Warm diya glow is the key light, with deep shadows at the edges. Macro tilt-shift photograph, 100mm macro lens, f/2.8, high-angle three-quarter view. Photorealistic, rich amber and crimson colour grade. Hammered brass reflections, silk sheen, tiny embroidery stitches, a flickering flame. No text. Aspect ratio 4:5.
tip: Change the outfit colours to match what you and your sibling wear.
